doc_name: 国务院关于钢铁行业化解过剩产能实现脱困发展的意见（国发〔2016〕6号）
quote_zh: 不得以任何名义、任何方式备案新增产能的钢铁项目
quote_en: No new-capacity steel projects may be filed under any name or in any form.
notes: Target: cut a further 100-150 Mt of crude steel capacity in 5 years; close furnaces of 400 m3 and below, 30 t converters/electric furnaces and 地条钢 immediately. Support side: encourage M&A and international capacity cooperation, smart-manufacturing demonstration, 引导…与“互联网+”融合.

doc_name: 国务院关于钢铁行业化解过剩产能实现脱困发展的意见（国发〔2016〕6号）
quote_zh: 重点推进高速铁路、核电、汽车、船舶与海洋工程等领域重大技术装备所需高端钢材品种的研发
quote_en: Focus on R&D of high-end steel grades needed for major equipment in high-speed rail, nuclear, autos, ships and offshore engineering.
notes: Sub-concept with opposite stance to the headline.

doc_name: 国务院关于钢铁行业化解过剩产能实现脱困发展的意见（国发〔2016〕6号）
quote_zh: 推广应用钢结构建筑，结合棚户区改造、危房改造和抗震安居工程实施
quote_en: Promote steel-structure buildings, combined with shantytown, dilapidated-housing and earthquake-resistant housing projects.
notes: Demand-side measure for steel; mapped to 专业工程 (steel structure engineering) - judgement.
